title: Dashboard and Balance at a Glance
audience: New PayProxy users checking money on phones
objectives: Learn how to read your total available balance at a glance on the Dashboard
Understand what each virtual card summary shows, including name, spend and status
Use the mobile-first glanceable design to check your money quickly and confidently

analogy.title: Your Car Dashboard Fuel Gauge
analogy.text: Think of your PayProxy Dashboard like the dashboard in your car. You don't open the hood to check your fuel; you glance at the fuel gauge. In the same way, you don't dig through statements to know your money. Your balance is the big, clear number at the top, always visible. Below it, your virtual cards are like trip meters showing spend per journey. It's designed for a quick, calm check while you're on the move, just like checking your speed, not rebuilding your engine.

pitch30Seconds: Open PayProxy and the first thing you see is your balance, large and clear. No clutter, no confusion, just how much you have right now. Scroll slightly and you'll see your virtual cards, each with its own summary: name, last spend, and status. It's your money, organized for a quick check on your phone. Designed to feel calm and trustworthy, so you can make confident decisions in seconds, anywhere you are.
keyPoints: Your total balance is always visible at the top for an instant, at-a-glance check
Each virtual card has a clear summary showing its name, recent spend and current status
You only see your own data — the Dashboard is private and personalized to your account
In test mode the balance is sample money for practice, not your real funds

recallQuiz.question: What does the Dashboard show first when you open PayProxy?
options: Your total balance at a glance
A full list of all transactions
recallQuiz.explanation: The Dashboard is designed to show your total balance first as the most important, glanceable information.

recallQuiz.question: What does a virtual card summary on the Dashboard include?
options: Card name, recent spend and status
recallQuiz.explanation: Each card summary gives a quick overview of that card’s name, how much was spent and whether it is active.

recallQuiz.question: Why is a glanceable balance important for mobile users?
options: So you can check your money quickly and confidently on the go
So you must use a desktop computer
So you can share your balance publicly
So you never need to look at your cards
recallQuiz.explanation: A clear, glanceable balance lets you make fast, confident decisions from your phone without digging through details.

testModeNote: In test mode your Dashboard shows a sample balance for practice. No real money is moved or displayed until you switch to live mode.
